answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 8408 Country: United States of America Title: Is it allowed for a women to call her husband by his name? Is it better not too? What is the daleel/proof for this? Question: Is it allowed for a women to call her husband by his name? Is it better not too? What is the daleel/proof for this? Answer ID: 8408 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1304/1119=L/1429) It is makrooh for a woman to call her husband with his name: ویکرہ ان یدعو الرجل اباہ وان تدعو المراۃ زوجھا باسمہ ( الدر المختار مع الشامی 9:599 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
